body.p: The Office Action dated December 21, 2023 has been received and carefully noted. The above amendments and following remarks are being submitted as a full and complete response thereto. Reconsideration of the application is respectfully requested in view of the foregoing amendments and following remarks.

By the foregoing amendment claims 1, 20, 41 and 42 have been amended, claim 39 has been cancelled, and no new claims have been added. Support for the amendment may be found in the specification and figures as originally filed, therefore no new matter is added. Thus claims 1- 38 and 40-42 are currently pending in the application and subject to examination.
Claims 1-2, 20-21, and 41-42 stand objected due to certain informalities. The cited portions have been removed and as such Applicant respectfully requests the objection be withdrawn.

Claims 1-38 and 40-42 stand rejected on the grounds of non-statutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claims 1-35 of U.S. Patent No. 11,449,021 in view of U.S. Publication No. 2015/0336271 (hereinafter "Spicer").
Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection.
Applicant asserts the independent claims recite:
calculating a second calculated location of the first feature of the
first subcomponent;
measuring a second measured location of the first feature of the
first subcomponent;
determining a second transformation matrix between the second
calculated location and the second measured location;
repositioning the first feature of the first subcomponent to the first target location using the first robot, the repositioning based on the
second transformation matrix.
Further Applicant asserts that the cited reference claims substantially different subject
matter than the subject matter recited in the independent claims. Applicant therefore respectfully requests the non-statutory double patenting rejection be withdrawn.

If for any reason the Examiner feels the application is not now in condition for allowance it is respectfully requested that they contact, by telephone, the undersigned practitioner at the indicated telephone number to arrange for an interview to expedite the disposition of this case.

Other than any fees submitted herewith, Applicant believes no further fees are owing. However, if a fee is due, please charge our Deposit Account Number 01-2300, under number 038191.00931 from which the undersigned is authorized to draw.

If this communication is filed after the shortened statutory time period had elapsed and no separate Petition is enclosed, Applicant(s) hereby petition, under 37 C.F.R. @ 1.136(a), to extend the time for filing a response to the outstanding Office Action by the number of months necessary to avoid abandonment under 37 C.F.R. § 1.135. Please charge any such fee under 37 C.F.R. § 1.17 to Deposit Account No. 01-2300.
